task: External compatibility of staged substance names and ATC assertions
population: All 1569 frozen EMA rows; unique substance/code pairs also reported
reference: Entire ATC-bearing ChEMBL molecule collection, release recorded from status endpoint
entity_resolution: NFKC Unicode normalization, casefold and whitespace collapse; exact preferred-name primary and exact synonym secondary; no ATC-assisted matching, fuzzy matching or salt stripping
ambiguity: More than one parent molecule yields unresolved; absent entity or code yields insufficient evidence, not false
classification: Exact code-set membership; syntactically valid ATC ancestor compatibility; official one-step named WHO alterations including ancestor-of-origin; partial multi-code support and malformed codes reported separately
clinical_scope: Substance classification compatibility, not current product authorization or payment eligibility
dependence: ChEMBL inherits WHO classification and can reuse regulatory information; an external acquisition is not an independent clinical gold standard
freeze: Initial exact-equivalence protocol and outcomes archived; granularity-aware refinement added after reviewing observed format discrepancies. No independent held-out validation claim.
